name: Focus Media Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Focus Media Information Technology Co., Ltd. delivers real-world advertising services to clients both within China and across the globe. The company's diverse array of promotional channels encompasses digital LCD displays, static and electronic poster frames, and commercial slots shown on cinema screens. Specifically, they offer advertising placements within elevators, via traditional poster formats, and as pre-show content in movie theaters. Founded in 2003, the firm manages its operations from its primary office situated in Shanghai, China.
